commits.subject: fix(copilot): mark memory tool findings as stale, require re-query for live facts

release_notes.text: Marked conversation-memory tool findings as historical snapshots so Copilot re-queries live read-only tools for candidate/run/position/notification questions instead of repeating stale conclusions (e.g. "0700 腾讯为什么被过滤" 复读旧结果而报「本轮未取得可验证的当前证据」).
